$about: capability -> the code globs that must move with its spec (R11). Keys starting with $ are metadata, not capabilities.
Empty at scaffold time: /spec-specify adds a capability's globs when it mints the spec (ADR-006: clean slate, no code yet).
Declare $unclaimed - the paths that belong to no capability - once there is code, so `spec-guard --audit` can report code nobody claims.
